entries.name: Undertow
entries.description: On entering battle, soaks the enemy side. Wild encounters are 20% rarer while it leads.

entries.name: Bulwark Hide
entries.description: Takes 30% less Earth damage. Foes can't lower its Physical Defense.

entries.name: Fog Weaver
entries.description: Field states it applies last 1 round longer.

entries.name: Chill Skin
entries.description: When hit by a physical move, 30% chance to Chill the attacker.

entries.name: Kindling
entries.description: Below a third of its HP, Fire moves hit 50% harder.

entries.name: Ember Trail
entries.description: When it faints, scorches the enemy side.

entries.name: Photosynth
entries.description: Heals 1/16 of its HP at the end of each round. Bond gains are 25% larger while it leads.

entries.name: Rootbed
entries.description: On entering battle, grows Overgrown on its own side. Can't be Dazed.

entries.name: Lightning Rod
entries.description: Electric damage heals it for 25% of its HP instead.

entries.name: Frost Guard
entries.description: Can't be Chilled. Takes half damage from Ice.

entries.name: Cold Snap
entries.description: On a knockout, +1 Speed. Earns 10% more XP while it leads.

entries.name: Finisher
entries.description: On a knockout, restores 15% energy. Scrap hits 50% harder.

entries.name: Guardian Aura
entries.description: Allies on the field take 10% less damage from moves.

entries.name: Reaction Spark
entries.description: Reactions it triggers deal 30% more. Its field states gain +1 stack.

entries.name: Slippery
entries.description: Can't be given a status. Rest restores an extra 15% energy.
